node_sequence.text: By history, clinical examination, or laboratory findings, are there signs and symptoms suggesting delirium due to an acute physical condition or medication side effects?
Are there other explanations for the symptoms such as dementia, depression, drug or alcohol intoxication or withdrawal?
Does the person present with acute agitation and/or acute aggression?
Is the person having an acute manic episode (e.g., elevated or irritable mood, decreased need for sleep, increased activity, impulsive behaviours lasting at least 1 week)?
Does the person have psychosis (at least two of: delusions, hallucinations, disorganized speech/behaviour)?
Consider consultation with a specialist to review other possible causes of psychosis.
